ModMetaData.name: RimStarWars: Cuisine
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Star Wars cuisine, general galaxy content (design/Jawa/proposals/high_cuisine_deep_design.md). Wave 1 — basic campfire skewer cooking: meat, veg, fungus, fruit and fish on a stick, plus the raw skewer resource, the "basic stuff" floor of the design's recipe-discovery ruling (owner, 2026-09-02: "Ingest the stuff on a stick mod into our own version and jettison that mod eventually... Let's take what we need and release them."). Absorbs badoaks.meatonastick and badoaks.meatonastick.expansion (workshop 3435027361 / 3577333297): defs and mechanism ported and renamed under our own naming scheme. Art regenerated in-house (STICK_FOOD_INGEST_1) — no donor pixels used, no license found on either donor mod. Both donor mods stay active pending retirement. This mod is the intended eventual home for the rest of high_cuisine_deep_design.md's build ladder (hazard-pantry, diplomacy meals, brewing, the Feastboss, the Nine-Course Ninefold Feast) as later waves land — chosen so this content lands in the right place from the start rather than needing a later move. Owner ruling, 2026-09-05: this replaces the earlier standalone RimUtinni-tier "Stick Cuisine" mod, which is retired — Star Wars cuisine content belongs in one shared galaxy-general mod, not scattered per-campaign.
